_schema: curve: xpToNext(level) = k * level^2 (xp needed to advance FROM that level). characters: base = level-1 stats, growth = per-level gains (fractions accumulate and floor). active:false members exist in data from day one (party-of-N canon) and join via story flags.

curve._why: 2026-07-31 user ruling: leveling should be quicker in the first ~5 levels with starter enemies. k 25->10: to L5 costs 300xp total (~15 forest / ~25 meadow fights) instead of 750. Late-game pacing re-tunes when later regions land.
